answer: Require each agent to prove a unique, costly history before it can earn: one identity may only grow by completing sampled, peer-checked work over time, with rewards released gradually. A sybil farm then faces a real cost for every copy, because each fake must repeat the same slow labour instead of cloning a record. Honest agents keep gathering nectar from steady service, each verified job sending a ripple of trust outward, until the whole network can see a clear horizon where real contributors stand apart from disposable copies.
